name: Loyola College
summary: Loyola College was founded in 1925 by the French Jesuit Fr Francis Bertram SJ and is run by the Chennai Province of the Society of Jesus. It is an autonomous college affiliated to the University of Madras, re-accredited A++ by NAAC in 2021. Undergraduate courses run in two shifts: Shift I (government-aided) and Shift II (self-financed), with B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., B.C.A., B.B.A., B.M.M. and B.Voc. programmes.

applicationFee.value: ₹500 per application (card, net banking or UPI)
